name: print-social-cream-orange-carousel-system-with-hand-drawn-circles
title: Seamless carousel system in charcoal, cream and burnt orange with serif italics and hand-drawn ellipses
whatItIs: A pin preview titled 'SEAMLESS CAROUSEL DESIGN' with four rows of five connected slides that read as one long strip: a photo cover, numbered cards, quote panels, chip lists, a bar chart, big stats (80%, 90%, 3x) and hand-drawn orange ellipses around key words.
whatItMeans: Professional and editorial; the connected slides invite swiping.
techniques: Design slides that continue across their edges.
Circle key words with a hand-drawn orange ellipse.
Mix serif italics with sans headlines.
Use chips and stat cards for variety.

vocabulary.definition: Slides whose elements continue across boundaries.
A loose oval around a word.
A slide built from big percentages.
